text:
Maya: Orca RFP update: they clarified they need immutable audit trails + tenant-level export for compliance. Timeline unchanged (end of Q2). Need 48h decision on scope. @Ren @Priya @Omar

Ren: From eng: parity-first pilot still the lowest risk. We can hit core asks quickly but need to be explicit about which Nautilus features we won't support in MVP.

Priya: Sales recommends parity MVP + written roadmap to differences. They need concrete dates to sign procurement.

Omar: Solutions: working on a minimal terraform example for control plane deployment. Also mapping which runtime hooks we can expose for tenant routing.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-7510 for audit-trail spec and compliance checklist.

legal-bot: Noted. I'll prepare pilot SLA template with the acceptance window and data custody terms.

Maya: Okay final call: proceed with 10-day spike to validate customer-managed control plane + audit delivery. If no major blockers, ship parity MVP with documented exceptions and kickoff SmartFallback roadmap. Owners same as before. Decision logged.

Ren: Starting spike tomorrow. Will post blockers in #eng-runtime.

Priya: I'll lock the commercial term sheet draft by EOD and share with legal.

Omar: Prepping terraform snippet and runbook.

Maya: Thanks team, closing the thread.
